a.lede: Google on Tuesday launched a new site that lets anyone verify whether a piece of media, be it an image, a video, or an audio clip, is generated using AI.
a.title: Google’s new SynthID website can identify AI-generated media

b.lede: The new SynthID website can now identify AI content from Google, OpenAI, and more.
b.title: Google rolls out improved SynthID AI content detector, now available globally
